data.title: Logbook order for vehicle BF-MU 412
data.summary: Kreis Beispielförde (traffic department) ordered you on 29 September 2026 to keep a logbook (Fahrtenbuch) for vehicle BF-MU 412 for six months, after a traffic offence on 14 July 2026 whose driver could not be identified.
data.explanation: The authority says a traffic offence was committed with your registered car and the driver could not be found. You must therefore keep a logbook (Fahrtenbuchauflage) for six months, starting when the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft). If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows until when. Otherwise the order becomes final and you must start the logbook. Consider professional advice if you want to contest it.
